title: Ruthless Loaded Strawberry Jelly Donut Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Jelly Donut by Ruthless is a dessert lover’s dream, capturing the taste of a warm, freshly baked donut filled with sweet and sticky Strawberry Jelly. The fluffy, golden-brown pastry flavour is complemented by the bright fruitiness of strawberry, delivering a smooth, indulgent vape with just the right balance of richness and sweetness. Just one of many astonishing and unique flavours from the Ruthless Shortfill collection, Strawberry Jelly Donut features a 70VG/30PG ratio, producing thick vapour and a full-bodied inhale. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing vapers to customise their nicotine strength. Ruthless has been redefining e-liquid flavour for over a decade, crafting bold and imaginative blends that continue to inspire vapers worldwide. Their commitment to quality ingredients and expert craftsmanship ensures a consistently premium vape experience.
